rules.hard_ceiling: Flag non-UK governing law without Head of Legal approval
rules.fallback_text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.
match_any: laws of the State of California

rules.preferred: Retain 100% ownership of background IP; customer gets limited license
rules.hard_ceiling: Never assign or transfer background IP / software copyrights
rules.fallback_text: PortSwigger retains all rights, title, and interest in its pre-existing Intellectual Property. Customer is granted a limited license to use deliverables as intended.

rules.preferred: Confidentiality term of 3–5 years after termination
rules.hard_ceiling: No perpetual/indefinite confidentiality except trade secrets
rules.fallback_text: Confidentiality obligations shall survive for three (3) years from the date of disclosure (except for Trade Secrets, which remain protected while they qualify as such).

rules.preferred: Counterparty must not retain majority ownership/control
rules.hard_ceiling: Never accept >=50% ownership or control by counterparty
